title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 3 is in. Relative `src`, `href`, and `srcset` are absolute, including several `srcset` candidates. A readable same-origin stylesheet becomes a `style` element. A cross-origin link stays a link. SVG elements set `isSVG`. An open shadow root is a child marked `isShadowRoot`.

`parseEvent` now accepts `isShadowRoot`. That field was not on the session node type, so `@rewind/shared` had to change. The reason is in ADR 0013 and ADR 0014.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Still open: parts 4 and 5 (privacy, form state, `takeFullSnapshot`). The issue definition of done is not met yet.
